name: shan-shui-statusbar
displayName: Shan Shui — Infinite Landscape Status Bar
description: Lightweight, colorful Shan Shui scenery scrolling across the native status bar with layered depth and day/night themes. A fresh random landscape every launch.

commands.title: Shan Shui: Restore Original Status Bar

shanShui.speed.description: Scroll speed in pixels per second. Set to 0 to pause. Apply changes with Enable / Repair Landscape, then reload.

shanShui.opacity.description: Landscape opacity. Existing status bar labels stay above the artwork.

shanShui.pauseWhenUnfocused.description: Pause scrolling while the VS Code window is unfocused.

shanShui.respectReducedMotion.description: Keep the landscape still when the operating system requests reduced motion.

shanShui.maxFPS.description: Maximum animation frames per second (10–30). Defaults to 20 to reduce CPU use.

enumDescriptions: Follow the system light/dark appearance automatically.
Always use the colorful daytime palette.
Always use the darker nighttime palette.
shanShui.mode.description: Landscape color mode: day, night, or the same as the system.
